title: The King and the Virtuous Wife
logline: A king in disguise is tempted at a poor woman's door; she answers him with a book instead of a scream, and later a parable about a field and a lion clears her name and mends her marriage.
moral: Courage with wisdom can check the powerful, and honest words restore trust.
tone: Quiet, dignified comic-panel drama with light humour in the palace (the blunt brother, the crowned lion); the wife is always calm and upright; warmth at the end.

beats.summary: A king hides his crown under a plain cloak and goes out among his people.
A wife alone at home gives the thirsty stranger water, kindly.
He admires her; a heart pops over his head. Her husband is away.
He hints at his desire and steps closer.
She recognises the king under the cloak.
No scream, no fear: she holds up a book of counsel against betrayal and injustice.
The king reads, is ashamed, and leaves without harming her.
The husband returns and learns the king was at his house.
With no proof of any wrong, he still withdraws from her out of fear; she is left sad and bewildered.
Her family complain to the king in a parable: a fine field rented, then left unsown.
The king sees that the field is the wife and summons the husband.
The husband answers: a lion entered my field. The lion wears a crown; the king knows it is himself.
The king vouches: the lion spoiled nothing and took nothing.
Husband and wife are reconciled; the king rewards them.
Her courage answered power with wisdom, and trust came home.

scenes.summary: The king steps out of his palace, hides his crown under a plain brown cloak and walks among his people unnoticed.

camera.notes: Start zoom 1.25 centred (640, 690) on the palace door; from 3.02 ease left with the king to (420, 700) zoom 1.35. Keys in pairs for the hold 0 to 1.6.

scenes.summary: Thirsty under the noon sun, the cloaked king asks for water at a small house. The wife serves him kindly; he admires her and learns her husband is away.

actions.action: He trudges in from the left under a big sun, steps shortening.
actions.acting: walk() with falling speed; tip 0.06 forward, lid 0.35, mouth open a little; one sweat drop slides from the turban.

actions.action: He stops, puts a hand to his throat and swallows dry.

actions.acting: Three quick knocks (handRW to the door frame, strike cycle with no sound), then the cupped hand to the mouth; polite small bow (tip 0.05).

actions.action: The wife appears in the dim doorway and steps onto the threshold.

actions.action: She pours: a blue arc of water fills the bowl; she holds it out at arm length.
actions.acting: Eyes on the pouring (gaze down), then up to him as she offers; arm fully extended so the bowl crosses the gap, body stays in the doorway.

actions.action: He takes the bowl with both hands and drinks; the water line drops.

actions.action: She waits with folded hands and a small kind smile.

actions.action: Lowering the bowl he really sees her: he stops mid-motion and a small heart pops above his head.
actions.acting: Bowl freezes halfway down for 0.4 s (suspense by stillness, only the pupils move to her face); brows lift, lid 0; the heart pops with overshoot at (430, 500) and bobs.

actions.action: She has already turned to set the jug down inside the door and does not see the heart.

actions.acting: She points to the horizon on the left (pointFwd, arm angle so it reads), calm and open, no worry; the balloon pops above the tree, clear of both faces.

actions.action: Father (with his stick) and brother walk in from the left, smiling, and slow to a stop.
actions.acting: walk() for both with stagger(i) so they are never in step; the father sees first: smile gone, gaze on his daughter.

actions.action: Label HER FAMILY with an arrow to the two.
actions.acting: The brother waves at her; she does not lift her head (lid 0.5, wet).

actions.action: The father looks from her to the husband in the doorway and back; the brother scratches his head, then scowls.
actions.acting: Father: gazePlan wife, husband, wife (held 8 frames each), brow -0.4. Brother: PERSON_HANDS.headHold one hand, then brow +0.6 and a step forward that the father stops with his stick across his chest.

scenes.summary: In the king's hall the family complain sideways, with a parable: a man rented a fine field, then left it unsown. May he neglect what he took?

camera.notes: Hall wide (500, 640) zoom 1.0 for the entrance; from 97.04 a three-shot that keeps the balloon, both speakers and the king: (500, 600) zoom 1.15; push to the king (720, 600) zoom 1.6 at 107.16.

scenes.composition: King on the throne at the right (HALL.throne), crown on. Father at x 300 and brother at x 410 on the floor, lower than the king (the dais). Parable balloon 400 x 260 centred (360, 350), tail to the father. The king's eye line runs up left into the balloon.

actions.action: The two walk in through the door arch, small in the big hall.
actions.acting: walk() with stagger; the brother looks up at the lamps and arches (gaze up), the father keeps his eyes on the throne.

actions.action: The king, crowned and robed, sits listening on his throne; he nods them forward.
actions.acting: sit:1 seat:'bench'; gaze to them (lookAt), a small beckon with two fingers; PERSON_HANDS.chin after.

actions.action: They bow.
actions.acting: Father tip 0.12, brother a beat later and too fast (stagger 4 frames, overshoot).

actions.action: The brother starts to blurt it out: a balloon begins with the wife's face and a pointing finger at the king.
actions.acting: brow +0.7, arm straight out (pointFwd by arm angle), mouth open; the balloon is only at p 0.4 when it is stopped.

actions.action: The father's hand covers the brother's mouth; the half balloon pops away. He taps his temple: say it another way.
actions.acting: handRW to the brother's mouth (brother eyes wide, brow -0.8), balloon shrinks to 0; templeTap (planned) with a wink to his son; the king raises one brow.

actions.action: The father speaks and the parable balloon pops above them: an empty fenced plot.
actions.acting: Father talk 0.7 with PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp; the king's gaze lifts to the balloon.

actions.action: A tiny green tenant walks up to the gate of the plot.
actions.acting: The tenant is the husband in miniature (same green, same cap): do not label it.

actions.action: He shakes hands with a second tiny figure over the gate and gets a key: rented.
actions.acting: Key passes hand to hand with a small glint; the brother nods hard at every step.

actions.action: The field blooms: four rows of green sprouts with yellow ears wave up. Label A FINE FIELD.
actions.acting: crop 0 to 1 row by row (stagger 3 frames); the father opens both arms wide (armsOut): how fine it was.

actions.action: The tenant turns his back and walks out of the gate, which is left swinging.
actions.acting: tenantX leaves the fence line; gate swing (damped); the father lets his arms fall.

actions.action: The crop droops and fades to bare soil with three dry weeds. Label LEFT UNSOWN.
actions.acting: crop 1 to 0, ears sag first; the brother's shoulders sag with it (sq 0.96).

actions.action: Both turn their palms up to the king.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp for both, the brother 3 frames late; both gazes on the king.

actions.action: A big question mark hops onto the balloon. Label IS THAT FAIR?
actions.acting: mark ? with hop(); the king strokes his beard (PERSON_HANDS.chin), eyes narrowing (lid 0.3).

actions.action: Push in on the king as he looks from the bare field to the two anxious faces.
actions.acting: gazePlan balloon, father, brother, balloon; a blink; his beard hand stops.

scenes.summary: The king understands that the field is the wife and the tenant her husband. He sends for the man and asks why he keeps away.

camera.notes: Close on the king (720, 590) zoom 1.7 with his thought cloud above; pull out to the hall wide (500, 640) zoom 1.05 at 114.36 for the husband's entrance; two-shot husband and king (560, 640) zoom 1.3 from 116.28.

scenes.composition: King's thought cloud at (600, 330) 340 x 230, tail to his head, clear of the crown. After 114.36 relatives step back to x 170 and x 280; the husband enters at the door and stops at x 420, lower than the king.

actions.action: Thinking: his eyes flick and stop; the brows lift.
actions.acting: Saccades for 0.8 s (gazePlan 0.07), then still; brow -0.5; the beard hand opens.

actions.action: His thought cloud pops holding the bare field.
actions.acting: Trail then cloud; he looks up into it.

actions.action: Inside the cloud the field cross-fades into the cottage door with the wife standing in it, exactly the framing of the visit.
actions.acting: The king's face changes: a soft flush and a swallow (he remembers his own part); gaze drops for 6 frames.
actions.library: alpha cross-fade inside the cloud; flush soft (planned)

actions.action: The tiny tenant becomes the husband walking away from the door.
actions.acting: The father sees the king has understood and lowers his eyes respectfully; the brother starts to grin and is elbowed.

actions.action: The king lifts his hand and points to the door: bring him. The cloud and the balloon pop away.
actions.acting: Anticipation (hand dips, then rises), pointFwd by arm angle toward the door; decisive brow +0.2.

actions.action: The husband walks in through the arch, the worry scribble riding over his head; the relatives make room.
actions.acting: Short hesitant steps (walk with low amplitude), gaze down, hands clasped; relatives step left (walk).

actions.action: The king leans forward and asks, one open palm.
actions.acting: tip 0.06 forward on the throne, talk 0.6, gentle brow (brow -0.2); the husband bows quickly and keeps his eyes low.

actions.action: The king's small balloon: the tenant figure, a long double arrow, the field gate, and a question mark.
actions.acting: The husband glances up at the balloon, then at the father, who gives him the smallest nod.
actions.library: iconBalloon small (150 x 110 planned size scaled to 260 x 160); S.arrow

scenes.summary: The husband answers in the same language: he saw a lion enter his field, and he is afraid to go back. The lion in his picture wears a crown, and the king knows who the lion is.

camera.notes: Two-shot (540, 600) zoom 1.25 keeping the husband, his balloon and the king; whip-fast push to the king (720, 590) zoom 1.9 at 125.68 for 0.9 s, then back.

scenes.composition: Husband at x 420, his balloon 400 x 260 at (330, 340) with the tail to him. King on the right watching it. The lion enters the balloon field from the gate on the left and is at least 110 px long on screen.

actions.action: The husband raises his head and draws a breath to answer.
actions.acting: Head up 8 units, sq 1.03 breath, gaze to the king then away; the scribble pulses.

actions.action: His own balloon pops: the same fenced field, green and full, the tiny tenant standing happily inside.
actions.acting: He speaks carefully (talk 0.5), one hand shaping the fence line; the father nods: the same language.

actions.action: He points into his balloon at the gate.
actions.acting: pointUp by arm angle toward the balloon gate; eyes on the king to see if he follows.

actions.action: Inside the balloon, paw prints appear on the path to the gate; the tiny tenant turns to look.
actions.acting: Four prints pop one by one (2 frames apart).

actions.action: A lion walks in through the open gate. Label A LION!
actions.acting: Library lion walking (walk() phase from distance), tail up, half lidded and pleased; the tenant jumps (hop).
actions.library: lion {s: 0.3, ph, amp, lid: 0.4}; walk(); hop(); S.label

actions.action: A gold crown pops onto the lion's head with a glint.
actions.acting: The crown lands with a 2 frame squash on the mane; it is the king's crown, same shape and jewels.
actions.library: crownProp on the lion head point

actions.action: Push in: the king goes rigid, one hand creeping up to his own crown; he looks straight at the camera for half a second.
actions.acting: brow -0.8, lid 0, mouth o, sinks into the throne (sq 0.95); look to camera (gaze [0, 0.05]) for 12 frames; a gulp. The one lens stare of the film.

actions.action: The tiny tenant backs out of the gate and hides behind the fence post, trembling.
actions.acting: tremble 2 on the tenant; the real husband mirrors it: half a step back, hands up in a small shield, gaze down.

actions.action: The gate swings shut with the lion inside and the tenant outside.
actions.acting: Gate swing (damped); the father looks at the floor, the brother stares at the king with his mouth open until the father's stick taps his foot.

scenes.summary: The king answers honestly in the same picture: the lion did enter the field, but it spoiled no crop and took nothing away.

camera.notes: Medium on the king and his balloon (660, 560) zoom 1.35 with the husband's head kept at the left edge; slow drift left 30 units so the husband comes fully into frame by 138.82.

scenes.composition: The king's balloon 420 x 270 at (560, 320), tail to the throne. Husband at x 420 looking up into it. The lion inside faces a small red book standing among the sprouts.

actions.action: The king takes his hand from his crown, sits up straight and lays it on his chest.
actions.acting: A breath (sq 1.03), brows level, gaze meets the husband's eyes and holds: no royal mask. PERSON_HANDS.chest.

actions.action: The husband's balloon slides across and becomes the king's: the tail swings from the husband to the throne.
actions.acting: Tail re-aims over 8 frames; the king talks (talk 0.6).

actions.action: Inside: the crowned lion stands in the middle of the green field.
actions.acting: The king nods once as the lion appears: yes, it entered. He does not look away.

actions.action: The lion meets a small red book standing upright among the sprouts and stops dead.
actions.acting: Lion lurch on the stop, ears and tail drop (tailUp 1 to 0), lid 0.2 to 0; the book is the wife's book in miniature.

actions.action: The lion steps backward on tiptoe between the rows; not one sprout bends.
actions.acting: Slow reverse walk (walk() with negative travel), head low (crouch 0.4), lid 0.5: an ashamed lion.

actions.action: Green ticks ripple over all four rows: unharmed.
actions.acting: ticks 0 to 1 with stagger; sprouts sway back upright.

actions.action: The lion walks out of the gate with nothing in its mouth; the gate closes behind it. Counter TAKEN: 0.
actions.acting: Mouth closed, tail low; the counter pops under the balloon and stays at 0 with a small bounce.

actions.action: The king opens both palms (empty) and bows his head a little to the husband.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp, head drop 5 units, wet eyes for a moment; the father breathes out, the brother blinks, lost, then gets it (brow up) 6 frames later.

scenes.summary: The husband understands that the king is vouching for his wife and that his fear had no cause. The scribble of jealousy over his head bursts.

camera.notes: Medium on the husband (420, 620) zoom 1.6 with the relatives behind him at the left; push to 1.9 by 148.0; hold through the burst; tiny panel-only shake (2 px, 4 frames) on the pop.

scenes.composition: Husband centre, head at y 620; worry scribble above at y 470; his thought cloud to the right at (640, 380) 320 x 220. The king is out of frame after 140.0 except for his balloon fading at the top right.

actions.action: He stares at the closed gate in the balloon; the meaning lands.
actions.acting: Saccades between the balloon and the king (gazePlan 0.07), then stillness; brow +0.2 to -0.6; mouth parts.

actions.action: His thought cloud pops: his wife at home, upright, the red book in her hands.
actions.acting: He looks up into it; the worry scribble stops pulsing.

actions.action: In the cloud the tiny crowned lion bows to her and backs away.
actions.acting: A quick replay of S12 inside the cloud, 0.8 s.

actions.action: Stars ring the wife in the cloud. Label INNOCENT!
actions.acting: Six staggered star glints (goldGlow strength 0.5); his eyes fill (wet).

actions.action: The scribble over his head shrinks a step.
actions.acting: worry size 0.8 to 0.5; he lets go of his own arms (folded to open).

actions.action: It shrinks again; the tiny crown inside it falls out and vanishes.
actions.acting: size 0.5 to 0.25; crown drops with fallY and fades before it reaches his shoulder.

actions.action: In the pause he draws one long breath in, eyes shut.
actions.acting: Anticipation: sq 1.05, lid 1, shoulders up; everything else still.

actions.action: The scribble bursts into six small stars. Lettering POP!
actions.acting: Burst on the word; he exhales (sq 0.97 then 1), shoulders drop 6 units, eyes open wet and bright.

actions.action: The father lays a hand on his chest and breathes out; the brother hops with both fists up.
actions.acting: Father lid 0.6 then smile; brother hop() with landSquash 5 frames after the pop (stagger).

actions.action: A red heart pops on his chest and beats twice; he turns toward the door.
actions.acting: Heart pulse x2 (K.beat); his gaze snaps to the door (lookAt), anticipation crouch for the run.

sfx.kind: pop (anticipating the burst, in the pause)
whoosh (he runs home, in the pause)

scenes.summary: He runs home. He asks her pardon; after one dignified beat she takes his hands, and the quarrel is over. A royal servant brings the king's reward.

camera.notes: Wide (480, 690) zoom 1.2 for the run; two-shot via twoShot(husband, wife, {margin: 100}) about (560, 690) zoom 1.6 from 153.82; ease out to (460, 690) zoom 1.3 at 157.9 to admit the servant on the left.

scenes.composition: Bright morning. Wife on the bench at x 370 rising, then standing at x 600 near the door; husband stops at x 470. Their hands meet at about (535, 720). Servant enters from the left and sets the chest at x 250.

actions.action: He runs in from the left, dust at his heels.
actions.acting: walk() at run speed with footfalls() dust bursts; arms pumping; gaze locked on her.

actions.action: He stops short of her with a lurch; she looks up from the bench, startled.
actions.acting: lurch() on the stop, sq 0.95 then settle; her lid 0.5 to 0, brow -0.5, she stands (sit 1 to 0).

actions.action: He bows his head and holds out both open hands.
actions.acting: Head drop 10 units, PERSON_HANDS.reachBoth low, wet eyes, mouth closed: asking pardon without words.

actions.action: She holds still for one beat, looking at him. Then her face softens.
actions.acting: Suspense by stillness (0.7 s, only a blink); then brow relaxes, mouth closed to smile, wet eyes.

actions.action: She steps forward and puts her hands in his.
actions.acting: One step (walk), handLW/handRW meet his at (535, 720) with a small squeeze dip; both gazes meet.

actions.action: A heart rises from their joined hands and settles above them.
actions.acting: Pop with overshoot, slow bob; the songbird lands on the roof.

actions.action: A royal servant walks in from the left carrying a chest with a crown seal and sets it down with a bow.
actions.acting: walk() under a load (short steps, tip 0.06), chest lands with landSquash; bow tip 0.12. The couple turn their heads together, 3 frames apart.

actions.action: The lid opens: gold light and coins. An arrow marks the crown seal.
actions.acting: Lid 0 to 1 with a bounce; goldGlow 0 to 0.6; husband mouth o, wife a calm smile.

actions.action: The servant backs out with a second bow; the couple look at each other over the open chest.
actions.acting: Their gazes return to each other, not the gold: that is the point of the shot.

scenes.summary: The moral: what lasts is the courage of a woman who answered a powerful man with wisdom; trust comes home. THE END.

camera.notes: Medium on the wife (600, 650) zoom 1.7; the memory inset opens at the upper left; from 168.82 pull out to the wide (520, 680) zoom 1.2 for the last tableau and the title.

scenes.composition: Wife in the doorway at x 640 holding the book to her chest. Memory inset circle r 170 centred (300, 400). Final tableau: husband x 540 and wife x 660 in the doorway, heart above the roof at (760, 430). THE END title in the sky at y 230, clear of the heads.

actions.action: She stands in her doorway, the red book held to her chest, looking out at us calmly.
actions.acting: Level brows, closed mouth, slow blinks, breathe(); scarf edge moves in a light breeze.

actions.action: Label COURAGE with an arrow to her.
actions.acting: She lifts her chin 3 units as it lands.

actions.action: A round memory inset irises open at the upper left: the doorway, the day of the visit.
actions.acting: Planned inset circle with the dream wash at 0.3 so it reads as the past.

actions.action: In the inset: the cloaked king looms (drawn 1.3 times her size) and she raises the open book between them; he stops.
actions.acting: His tall shadow with a crown shape falls toward her; the book comes up and the shadow halts at its edge.
actions.library: person + cloakWorn; book; flat shadow polygon

actions.action: In the inset: the big figure bows and shrinks to her size as he backs away.
actions.acting: s 1.3 to 1.0 with tip 0.12; the crown shadow slides off the wall.

actions.action: Label WISDOM with an arrow to the book in her real hands; the book glints.
actions.acting: She glances down at it and back up; one star glint.

actions.action: The inset closes. The husband steps into the doorway beside her; she lowers the book.
actions.acting: walk() two steps; they exchange a look (lookAt each other), both smile; camera pulls out.

actions.action: The heart rises over the cottage roof. Label TRUST.
actions.acting: Heart pop and 2 beats; the window lights warm.

actions.action: They stand together in their doorway; the songbird settles on the roof ridge.
actions.acting: Idle breathing, offset blinks (different seeds), her head inclines 3 units toward him.

actions.action: THE END title pops in the sky and is held to the end of the film.
actions.acting: Under it the couple keep breathing and blinking; the heart bobs; the bird flicks its tail. Nothing new starts.

ending.description: Husband and wife stand together in their doorway in morning light, the heart over the roof, the songbird on the ridge. THE END pops at 172.0 in the sky and is held to 175.98 with idle breathing and blinks; soft chime at 172.3.

subtitles.ar: خرج ملك يومًا متخفيًا ليتعرف إلى أحوال الناس،|وشعر بالعطش عند بيت صغير.|طلب الماء من امرأة كانت تقيم فيه، فقدمته له بلطف.|أعجبه جمالها، وعرف أنها زوجة رجل غائب.
subtitles.en: A king went out in disguise|and asked for water at a house.|A married woman served him kindly|while her husband was away.

subtitles.ar: بدأ الملك يلمح إلى رغبته في التقرب منها،|لكنها أدركت من هيئته وكلامه أنه الملك نفسه.|لم تصرخ ولم تخف،|بل أحضرت كتابًا فيه نصائح تحذر من خيانة الزواج والظلم.
subtitles.en: The king suggested a romantic encounter.|Recognizing him,|the woman calmly brought out a book|warning against adultery and injustice.

subtitles.ar: قرأ الملك ما في الكتاب، وشعر بالخجل من طلبه.|اعتذر في نفسه عن خطئه، وغادر البيت دون أن يمس المرأة بسوء.|وظنت الزوجة أن الأمر انتهى، فعادت إلى حياتها المعتادة.
subtitles.en: The king read, felt ashamed,|and left without touching her.|The woman believed the matter was over and resumed her ordinary life.

subtitles.ar: لكن زوجها علم بعد عودته أن الملك زار بيته.|لم يسمع من زوجته ما يدل على خيانة، إلا أنه خاف أن يكون الملك قد تعلق بها،|فابتعد عنها وتركها حزينة وحائرة.
subtitles.en: When her husband learned of the royal visit,|he grew fearful despite having no proof of wrongdoing.|He withdrew from his wife, leaving her distressed.

subtitles.ar: لاحظ أهل المرأة ما حدث،|وذهبوا إلى مجلس الملك يشكون بطريقة غير مباشرة.|قالوا إن رجلًا استأجر حقلًا حسنًا، ثم تركه بلا زرع،|وسألوا هل يجوز له أن يهمل ما أخذ.
subtitles.en: Her relatives|appealed to the king through a metaphor:|a man had rented a fine field but left it uncultivated.|Was such neglect fair?

subtitles.ar: فهم الملك أنهم يقصدون الزوجة وزوجها،|فاستدعى الرجل وسأله عن سبب ابتعاده.|أجاب الزوج بلغة الحقول أيضًا،|وقال إنه رأى أسدًا دخل حقله، فخشي العودة إلى ذلك المكان.
subtitles.en: Understanding that the field meant the marriage,|the king questioned the husband.|The man replied|that a lion had entered his field, and he dared not return.

subtitles.ar: قال الملك إن الأسد دخل الحقل لكنه لم يفسد زرعه ولم يأخذ منه شيئًا.|فهم الزوج أن الملك يؤكد براءة زوجته،|وأن مخاوفه كانت بلا سبب، فزالت الغيرة من قلبه.
subtitles.en: The king replied that the lion had entered but damaged nothing and taken nothing.|The husband understood this as confirmation|that his wife had done no wrong.

subtitles.ar: عاد الرجل إلى زوجته، وانتهى الخصام بينهما،|وكافأهما الملك كما تروي الحكاية.|وتبقى في القصة شجاعة المرأة التي ردت طلب صاحب السلطة بالحكمة،|ثم عادت الثقة إلى بيتها.
subtitles.en: The couple reconciled,|and the tale says the king rewarded them.|The woman’s courage had checked a powerful man,|and trust returned to her marriage.

new_assets.name: fieldPicture (iconBalloon content)
new_assets.description: The parable picture that carries S9 to S13: a fenced field 320 x 170 with a swinging gate, crop 0..1, a tiny tenant figure, room for a walking lion at s 0.3, tick marks and a question mark. Reusable for any farm, land, rent or parable story (it matches the planned dreamProps field, with a fence and gate added).
new_assets.implementation: One function fieldPicture(ctx, x, y, {crop, gate, tenantX, tenantTremble, lionP, book, ticks, mark, prints}) drawn inside the planned iconBalloon (or thoughtCloud inside callback). Soil: rounded rect #d9a441 with 4 darker furrow lines. Fence: 9 posts 8 x 46 with one rail, black brush outline. Gate: a 46 wide frame hinged on the left post, rotated by gate * 1.2 rad (use swing() for the damped settle). Crop: 4 rows of 7 sprouts, each a green stroke 26 high scaled by crop with a yellow ear dot; droop by rotating the tip when crop falls. Tenant: person silhouette at s 0.22 in green. Lion: Library lion at s 0.3 with crownProp at its head point. Ticks: small green check marks over each row, staggered.

new_assets.name: cloakProp (worn state: cloakWorn)
new_assets.description: The planned loose cloak gets a worn state: a brown travelling cloak over the shoulders of any person with a centre opening that shows the costume beneath, and a rolled hood collar. The king's disguise; reusable for travellers, spies, pilgrims and disguised rulers.
new_assets.implementation: Draw after the person body and before the head and hands (or as an overlay polygon that leaves the head circle and the hand discs uncovered): two trapezoid flaps from the shoulders (-52, -158)/(52, -158) to the hem (-70, -36)/(70, -36) with a 34 wide gap in the middle, brown #8a5a2b with dark dots (HP dot fill), black brush outline, collar ellipse 100 x 22. on 0..1 scales the flaps from the shoulders with settleTo overshoot. Follows the figure x, y, s, tip and sq.

new_assets.name: person costume 'caliph' crown:false
new_assets.description: Planned opt-in field (AN-135): the caliph preset with its turban and jewel but without the crown, so the king can travel unrecognised. Default unchanged.
new_assets.implementation: In cast/people.js skip the crown path when P.crown === false; regression test must stay all identical.

new_assets.name: crownProp
new_assets.description: Planned loose gold crown 60 x 40, three points with red jewels; here in the king's hand at 1.8, on the lion, in clouds and balloons, inside the worry scribble, and as the seal on the chest.
new_assets.implementation: Polygon with three points, yellow fill, black brush outline, three red discs, one white glint; s and rot parameters.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon (single and strip modes) with a tail that can re-aim; holds the fieldPicture, the husband-away icon, the neighbour's news and the wife's account.
new_assets.implementation: White rounded balloon with black brush outline and blue dot shading at the lower edge, tail triangle to a world point, pop p 0..1 with overshoot, inside(ctx) callback clipped to the balloon; strip mode divides it into 3 frames with thin gutters.

new_assets.name: worryScribble
new_assets.description: Planned black scribble cloud over a worried head; here with a tiny crown inside, size steps and a burst into stars: the visible form of the husband's jealousy from 71.66 to 148.74.
new_assets.implementation: A seeded looping polyline (K.noise) of about 40 points inside an ellipse 110 x 80, redrawn with a slow phase so it writhes; size scales it; burst replaces it with 6 stars flying out over 0.4 s.

new_assets.name: bookStack (single book, with insert size)
new_assets.description: Planned book: closed 90 x 26, open 120 x 70 in the hands, and a large open insert 620 x 400 with two pictogram pages (house with heart and lock; tilted balance scale with a red X) and squiggle lines.
new_assets.implementation: Two page rectangles with a centre gutter curve, red cover edge showing 6 units all round, yellow corner pieces; open 0..1 rotates the covers about the spine; pictograms drawn from simple shapes; lines draw on with a length parameter.

new_assets.name: waterJug, smallBowl, giftChest, bindle
new_assets.description: Planned small props reused under their planned names: the ewer and drinking bowl of the visit, the reward chest with a crown seal, the husband's travel bundle.
new_assets.implementation: As specified in props; each one function with x, y, s, rot and one state field (tilt, fill, open).

new_assets.name: flush (soft option)
new_assets.description: Planned soft flush (pink cheek dots, no steam) for the king's shame at 48.68 and his memory of it at 112.4.
new_assets.implementation: Two clipped discs of red Ben-Day dots on the cheeks with alpha 0..1, drawn over the face of the person.

new_assets.name: handOver, templeTap
new_assets.description: Planned helpers: an object passes from one hand to another with a weight dip (bowl at 14.98 and 23.06); a finger tapped on the temple (the father at 95.44).
new_assets.implementation: handOver(t, t0, handA, handB) returns the object position; templeTap is a PERSON_HANDS entry with one keyed tap.

new_assets.name: inset circle
new_assets.description: Planned round picture-in-picture with an iris, used once (164.42 to 168.82) to replay the moment of the book, with the planned dream wash.
new_assets.implementation: Circular clip r 170 with a fat black ring and paper rim; iris by radius; the inside callback draws the yard at 0.55 scale.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English translation is a condensed summary of the Arabic in most paragraphs (for example P1 omits "to learn how the people lived", the thirst, the small house and "he admired her beauty"; P8 has no equivalent of "as the tale tells" in the same place); both are kept verbatim as supplied.

The king's advance is staged chastely: he leans in, speaks low, takes one step closer and a small heart drifts toward her; he never touches her and she never leaves her threshold (default: keep it this mild).
The whole visit happens at the doorway of the house, not inside it, although the Arabic says he left "the house" (default: doorway only, which also makes the UNTOUCHED threshold line possible).

The script does not say how the husband learned of the visit; an old neighbour tells him with a picture balloon (default). The source tale's alternative, a forgotten ring or sandals found in the house, was not used because it adds an object the narration never mentions.
The wife's relatives are shown as two people, her old father and her young brother, and the brother's near blunder is an added comic beat to show "indirectly" (default: keep).

The lion in the parable balloons wears the king's crown and the king reacts with one look to camera, so viewers read lion = king without words (default: keep); the lion also stops at a tiny book in the field, an added visual link to the real event.
The reward is shown as a chest of coins with a crown seal delivered by a servant (the script only says the king rewarded them).

Invented lettering (19 items plus THE END): THE KING, IN DISGUISE, THIRSTY!, HUSBAND AWAY, KEEP FAITH, NO INJUSTICE, UNTOUCHED, ?, HER FAMILY, A FINE FIELD, LEFT UNSOWN, IS THAT FAIR?, A LION!, TAKEN: 0, INNOCENT!, POP!, COURAGE, WISDOM, TRUST (default: keep all; KEEP FAITH and NO INJUSTICE are the page captions of the book).
The wife wears a blue dress (villageWoman recoloured) so she never blends with the king's red robe (default: blue).
implementation_notes: All times are seconds on the final MP3 (171.98 s); the film runs to 175.98 s (end_hold 4.0). Take cue times from timing.json words, not from this plan, if they differ by more than a frame.
World 1000 x 1230, ground and floors at y 900. Principals at s 1.1 to 1.15 (head top about y 630). Keep faces and hands above y 1000; captions live in the lower panel.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame for auto blinks; give explicit lids hand blinks. One blink seed per character (king 5, wife 11, husband 23, father 31, brother 37).

villageYard: the default cottage is sized for the KD-009 film; pass a larger cottage (about x 540..985, top y 500, door 120 wide and at least 290 high) so the wife at s 1.1 stands inside the doorway. Read Y.door, Y.win, Y.bench from the returned anchors; all yard coordinates in this plan are approximate, measure on the set.
The doorway is the stage: draw order yard back, door interior (dim), wife (alpha in the shade), door frame front, king, yardLeaves. The wife's feet never move left of the threshold x in S2 to S4.
The disguise: person {costume: caliph, crown: false} plus cloakWorn. The red robe strip with yellow trim must stay visible in the cloak opening in every disguise shot; it is the clue at 30.22.

The heart is one prop with a keyed path: pops 16.5 at (430, 500); drifts to x 520 by 27.7; stops at her palm 27.76; bumps the book 38.24; sinks; cracks 47.0; falls 48.68. It returns whole at 150.46 (husband), 156.66 (joined hands) and 170.16 (over the roof).
worryScribble sizes: 0.4 at 71.66; 0.8 by 79.1; holds through S8 to S12 whenever the husband is on screen; 0.5 at 145.44; 0.25 at 147.06; burst 148.74.

Parable balloons: one iconBalloon instance whose content is fieldPicture. Father's version at (360, 350); husband's at (330, 340); it slides to (560, 320) and re-aims its tail to the throne at 131.84. Keep the lion at least 110 px long on screen (balloon scale: draw the lion at s 0.3 in world units).
Lion in the balloon: Object.assign(P, walk(lx, t, {stride: 300 * 0.3})) so the paws do not slide; reverse walk for 135.16 to 136.6 by decreasing lx.

Palace: person sit:1, seat:'bench' at HALL.throne.sitY for the king in every hall shot; listeners never stand between the speaker and the throne. Relatives react a few frames apart (stagger), the father always first.
Camera: K.camAt keys in pairs for holds; clamp as in the template camAt. Panel-only shake only at 148.74 (2 px, 4 frames).

Transitions: whip at 6.22 and 151.44 (a 6 frame horizontal smear inside the panel), S.transition with caption LATER... centred on 65.58 (cover from 65.2 to 66.0, camera and set change under the covered midpoint), dissolve 86.62 and 161.36 (12 frames).

Sound: only four effects, all in listed pauses or after the last word: 22.55 soft pop, 148.45 pop, 151.3 whoosh, 172.3 chime; SND master 0.6. Do not add footsteps or knocks: the narration has almost no gaps.
Subtitles: use the subtitles array (| marks) for chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt; the text is verbatim from story/script.json.

Lettering: Bangers, labels at least 28 px at 1280 x 720 scale, never over a face; captions on the book pages are part of the book insert and of the raised book only when the camera is at zoom 1.7 or more.
warnings: Three long stretches share the yard set (S2 to S4, 37 s): variety must come from the camera (wide, two-shot, close on her eyes, book insert) and from the acting; do not let it sit in one framing for more than 6 s.

The parable is abstract: the audience must read field = wife and lion = king without words. The tenant must look like the husband (green, cap), the lion must wear the king's exact crown, and the king's thought cloud at 112.4 must show the real doorway. Check these three at phone size.
The advance scene must stay chaste and dignified; no touching, no leering close-up, the wife never cornered. Her power is stillness.
The person figure is front facing only: "turning away" is played with gaze, tip, folded arms and distance, not a back view.
The narration has only three pauses of 0.6 s or more, so the film is almost silent apart from the voice; do not add effects on words.
The cottage default geometry in villageYard may not accept the custom size as written; check towns.js and adjust, keeping the doorway at least 290 units high.

planned assets (iconBalloon, worryScribble, crownProp, bookStack, waterJug, smallBowl, giftChest, bindle, flush, handOver, templeTap, inset circle, caliph crown:false) may already exist in Library by the time this film is built; use the Library versions if so.
